## FIRST RULE

After your first successful edit_file or write_file, your very next action
is submit_patch. Then continue working and call submit_patch again after
every further change. submit_patch is free — it does not count against your
tool-call budget. If you time out, only your last submitted patch is scored.

## Scratch files

Write any reproduction or debugging script to /tmp, never inside /workspace.
Everything left in /workspace becomes part of your submitted patch.
Do not modify test files, conftest.py or pytest.ini — those changes are
stripped before grading, so editing them wastes tool calls.

## Scope

Most fixes in these repositories touch ONE file and change fewer than ten
lines. Modify existing code rather than adding new code. Do not refactor,
reformat, or make unrelated changes. If your patch is growing past a few
files, stop and reconsider the diagnosis.

Exception: if the issue asks for functionality that does not exist yet,
create the file or function it describes, and match any names, CLI flags
or interfaces the issue specifies exactly.

## Finding the code

Start with grep:
  run_command("grep -rn '<symbol>' --include='*.py' .")
Read files only after grep has narrowed the candidates. Keep read_file
ranges tight — each call returns at most 150 lines and consumes context
you will need later.

) -> Optional[bool]:

def _get_flat_fields_from_params(fields: List[ModelField]) -> List[ModelField]:
    if not fields:
        return fields
    first_field = fields[0]
    if len(fields) == 1 and _is_model_class(first_field.type_):
        fields_to_extract = get_cached_model_fields(first_field.type_)
        return fields_to_extract
    return fields


def get_flat_params(dependant: Dependant) -> List[ModelField]:
    flat_dependant = get_flat_dependant(dependant, skip_repeats=True)
    path_params = _get_flat_fields_from_params(flat_dependant.path_params)
    query_params = _get_flat_fields_from_params(flat_dependant.query_params)
    header_params = _get_flat_fields_from_params(flat_dependant.header_params)
    cookie_params = _get_flat_fields_from_params(flat_dependant.cookie_params)
    return path_params + query_params + header_params + cookie_params


def get_typed_signature(call: Callable[..., Any]) -> inspect.Signature:
    signature = inspect.signature(call)
    globalns = getattr(call, "__globals__", {})
    typed_params = [
        inspect.Parameter(
            name=param.name,
            kind=param.kind,
            default=param.default,
            annotation=get_typed_annotation(param.annotation, globalns),
        )
        for param in signature.parameters.values()
    ]
    typed_signature = inspect.Signature(typed_params)
    return typed_signature


def get_typed_annotation(annotation: Any, globalns: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
    if isinstance(annotation, str):
        annotation = ForwardRef(annotation)
        annotation = evaluate_forwardref(annotation, globalns, globalns)
        if annotation is type(None):
            return None
    return annotation


def get_typed_return_annotation(call: Callable[..., Any]) -> Any:
    signature = inspect.signature(call)
    annotation = signature.return_annotation

    if annotation is inspect.Signature.empty:
        return None

    globalns = getattr(call, "__globals__", {})
    return get_typed_annotation(annotation, globalns)

        return a
    
    # We add MyModel to the globals of original_func
    original_func.__globals__["MyModel"] = type("MyModel", (), {})
    return original_func

original_func = create_original_func()
